source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 天湖空庭箫声
title: 空庭无人，箫声引路
purpose: 承接天湖初现，表现拓拔野与白龙鹿进入疑似青帝居所却遍寻无人，最后被东南方若有若无的箫声引向更深处。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 uses the previous Tianhu reveal storyboard for continuity. SH02 and SH03 use the Yuping/Tianhu location reference for empty residence identity. SH04 uses the white dragon-deer reference or location mood, depending on generation stability.
video_policy: Gemini experimental I2V should use only each generated and approved storyboard image as source of truth. No extra character or location references in video generation.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, or English words inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue. Chinese dialogue, flute sound design, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
